====================================
Model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct
Masking: random, sparsity=0.30
n_problems: 50, n_bootstrap: 1000, seed: 42

Phase Token Stats:
  high_sparsity: 16289 tokens, 295 segments
  mid_sparsity:  4372 tokens, 26 segments
  low_sparsity:  32227 tokens, 276 segments

Perplexity (s=0.30):
  Phase       | dense  | attn    | kv     | both
  high        | 1.074  | 12.741  | 4.279  | 38.553
  mid         | 1.132  | 2.562   | 5.944  | 25.962
  low         | 1.152  | 370.999 | 8.838  | 317.666

Interaction Index (s=0.30):
  Phase | mean     | median | median_CI          | winsorized_mean | skewness | outliers
  high  | 21.058   | 3.955  | [3.516, 5.605]     | 12.031          | 13.902   | 2
  mid   | 15.567   | 6.398  | [3.377, 10.000]    | 12.069          | 3.528    | 1
  low   | -33.242  | 8.196  | [5.766, 10.922]    | 19.803          | -11.436  | 3

Pass/Fail Assessment:
  ci_overlap_test:    PASS (high vs low CI non-overlapping)
  sign_reversal_test: FAIL (mean sign reversal: low mean=-33.24 is negative)
  overall:            PASS (built-in assessment)

  Median trend: 3.955 → 6.398 → 8.196 (monotonically increasing ✓)
  median_diff (low - high): +4.241
  Note: Adjacent phase median CIs overlap (high-mid, mid-low)

Comparison with other random masking experiments:
  s=0.15: median 0.138→0.219→0.188, diff=+0.050, FAIL (sign_reversal + ci_overlap)
  s=0.20: median 0.485→0.767→0.614, diff=+0.129, FAIL (sign_reversal + ci_overlap)
  s=0.25: median 1.604→2.222→2.264, diff=+0.660, FAIL (ci_overlap)
  s=0.30: median 3.955→6.398→8.196, diff=+4.241, PASS (high-low CI separated)

Observation: As sparsity increases, interaction index magnitude grows and
the phase gradient becomes more pronounced. At s=0.30 the median trend
achieves clean monotonic ordering with non-overlapping high-low CIs,
unlike lower sparsity levels. However, the large negative mean for
low_sparsity (driven by 3 outliers with skewness=-11.4) suggests
high variance and fragile results.
